summary: Join our Corporate Social Responsibility Partnerships Training Course to master the art of impactful partnerships and drive meaningful change in your community.
lede: CSR partnership training helps professionals who plan or manage social impact collaborations align business priorities with community needs. It covers stakeholder mapping, partner assessment, program co-design with partners and communities, governance and risk management, and practical ways to track and communicate outcomes using relevant indicators and reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, manage, or influence CSR partnerships and social impact collaborations.
audience: Corporate affairs, brand, and communications professionals
Community investment, philanthropy, or social impact officers
modules: Foundations of CSR and Strategic Partnerships
Designing High Impact CSR Partnership Models
Co-creating Programs with Partners and Communities
Managing Risk, Reputation, and Power Dynamics
Communicating CSR Partnerships and Storytelling for Impact
Building and Sustaining Long Term CSR Partnerships
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of CSR concepts and experience in project management or stakeholder engagement.
